mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 250, the combination signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 250
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 250, 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1200) indicate weak economic demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1200, 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates weak economic supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals weak labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 1200 and residential sales (RSAFS) are below 500000, weak demand conditions signal negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 500000, 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising > 0.3pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 250), the combination signals reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 250
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 250, 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.
